title: Multiplication Layer
source_docs: Deep Learning Toolbox/Deep Learning Layers/Combination Layers/Multiplication_Layer.md
text: Multiplication layer, 3 inputs, 1 output, {Data format} sets Format of input data; {Number of inputs} sets the number of values to layer block, {Output minimum} sets the minimum output value for range checking, {Output maximum} sets the maximum output value for range checking, {Output data type} sets the data type of output, {Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools} sets the option to prevent fixed-point tools from overriding Output data, {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action and {Sample time} sets the option to specify sample time. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: First input data scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: Port_2
ports.summary: Second input data scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: Port_N
ports.summary: N th input data scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Number of inputs
params.values: Number of values to layer block 2 (default) | 3 | 4 | 5

params.name: Data format
params.values: Format of input data SSC (default) | C | CT | SC | SSSC

params.name: Output minimum
params.values: Minimum output value for range checking [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Output maximum
params.values: Maximum output value for range checking [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Data type of output Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Keep MSB | Inherit: Match scaling | Inherit: Inherit via back propagation | Inherit: Same as first input |

params.name: Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Option to prevent fixed-point tools from overriding Output data type off (default) | on

params.name: Integer rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode for fixed-point operations Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Method of overflow action off (default) | on

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Option to specify sample time -1 (default) | scalar
